questions.q: Which mineral deficiency is the most common nutritional deficiency in young children, often related to excessive milk consumption (>24 oz/day)?
questions.explain: Excessive milk intake ('milk anemia') displaces iron-rich foods and milk itself is low in iron, leading to Iron Deficiency Anemia.

questions.q: When assessing a child's growth, a BMI falling between the $85^{th}$ and $95^{th}$ percentile on the CDC growth charts indicates:
questions.explain: CDC definitions: BMI $\ge 95^{th}$ percentile is Obese; $85^{th}$ to $<95^{th}$ is Overweight.

questions.q: A 4-year-old child consumes a strict vegan diet. Which vitamin supplement is absolutely essential to prevent neurological damage?
questions.explain: Vitamin B12 is found naturally only in animal products. Strict vegans of any age require supplementation or fortified foods to prevent nerve damage and anemia.

questions.q: Which of the following is considered the 'Gold Standard' for diagnosing food allergies in children, although it is done under medical supervision?
questions.explain: The double-blind, placebo-controlled food challenge is the most definitive way to diagnose a food allergy, removing bias.
